report.summary: An impact between car-0 and car-1 occurred at t = 4.672 s, with timing uncertainty about 0.042 s. From t = 3.472 to 4.472 s, car-0 travelled at 30.0 km/h (90% interval 27.6 to 32.2) and car-1 travelled at 51.9 km/h (90% interval 48.1 to 56.0). The s1 claim about the speed of the white car was not consistent with the footage, while the s2 claim about the speed of the blue car was consistent with the footage. The s2 claim that the white car did not brake was consistent with the footage, with no sustained braking detected before impact, and the s1 claim about the light being green cannot be checked from the footage.
limitations: Frame times come from the burned-in clock; frames the recorder dropped were placed using the vehicles' own motion.
Road calibration error: 0.481 m (how well the clicked road points fit a flat road); positions assume a flat road.

The momentum check after the impact did not balance (inconsistent): after contact the vehicles overlap in the image, so post-impact motion is not reliable. Speeds before the impact are measured separately and are not affected.
Traffic-light claims cannot be checked: 5 traffic lights in view (traffic_light-0, traffic_light-1, traffic_light-2, traffic_light-3, traffic_light-4); choose which one governs the stop line.
